title: Pack Source Mapping
description: Maps each card to the pack(s) it can be obtained from in Pokémon TCG Pocket. Built from Limitless TCG Pocket data. Do not fabricate entries.

set_code.description: Set code as used by Limitless TCG Pocket (e.g. A4b, B1, B1a)

pack_name.description: Pack within the set this card drops from (null if available in all packs or pack-independent)

expansion.description: Expansion name (e.g. Celestial Guardians, Space-Time Smackdown)

rarity.description: Rarity code (e.g. one_diamond, two_diamond, one_star, double_star, crown)

is_promo.description: True if this card is a promo / not obtainable from standard packs

source_url.description: URL of the source page for this mapping

notes.description: Any notes about availability, exclusivity, or data quality
